search_request.question: Which requirements define Ethernet bandwidth between the Central Gateway and ADAS controller?

chunk.section: Automotive Ethernet Architecture Requirements / Physical Ethernet interfaces
chunk.text:
REQ-ETH-002:
The communication path between the Central Gateway (gateway) and ADAS Domain
Controller (adas) shall use switch-core and two links, link-gateway and link-adas,
each supporting a nominal bandwidth of at least 1000 Mbps using 1000BASE-T1.
This is a switched path, not a direct gateway-to-ADAS cable.

chunk.section: Automotive Ethernet Architecture Requirements / Physical Ethernet interfaces
chunk.text:
REQ-ETH-001:
The Central Gateway (gateway) shall connect its eth0 interface to Ethernet Switch
switch-core port p1 using 1000BASE-T1 with a nominal link bandwidth of 1000 Mbps.

chunk.section: Centralized E/E Architecture Overview / Central compute and gateway
chunk.text:
SYS-REQ-101:
The Central Gateway (gateway) shall connect the central Ethernet Switch (switch-core)
through link-gateway and the Body Controller (body) through CAN link-body-can at 1 Mbps.
Physical connectivity shall not imply CAN-to-Ethernet protocol translation.
